li.label: no new stars
li.description: More than fifteen days without charting a new system. We are supposed to be explorers.

li.label: new stars charted
li.description: We charted new systems recently. This is our purpose.

PreceptDef.label: duty
PreceptDef.description: Exploring the unknown is a sacred duty. Believers are happy while new systems keep being charted, and restless when exploration stops.

li.label: many peoples known
li.description: We know many peoples among the stars. The galaxy feels less lonely.

li.label: foreign ties
li.description: We made pacts with outsiders. They will corrupt us.

PreceptDef.label: welcomed
PreceptDef.description: Meeting other civilizations is good. Believers are happy when many peoples are known.

PreceptDef.label: isolationist
PreceptDef.description: Outsiders are a danger. Believers dislike trade agreements and alliances with other civilizations.

li.label: gate pilgrimage
li.description: We passed through an ancient gate. It felt like walking into a cathedral.

li.label: crossed a gate
li.description: We went through one of those ancient things. Nothing made by the dead should be trusted.

PreceptDef.label: sacred
PreceptDef.description: The ancient gates are holy. Passing through one is a pilgrimage.

PreceptDef.label: feared
PreceptDef.description: The ancient gates are cursed works of the dead. Believers hate using them.

li.label: sleepers aboard
li.description: The ship carries cryosleep caskets for the long dark. That is how our ancestors crossed the stars.

li.label: frozen souls
li.description: Someone is frozen in a casket here. A soul in ice is a soul stolen from time.

PreceptDef.label: sacred
PreceptDef.description: Cryosleep is the sacred way our ancestors crossed the void.

PreceptDef.label: forbidden
PreceptDef.description: Freezing a living person is an abomination.

li.label: spoils of the void
li.description: We won in space and the wreck is ours to strip. Fair is fair.

li.label: desecrated wreck
li.description: A destroyed ship is a tomb. Stripping it is desecration.

PreceptDef.label: honorable
PreceptDef.description: A wreck belongs to whoever won the battle.

PreceptDef.label: disrespectful
PreceptDef.description: Destroyed ships are graves of the void and must not be stripped.

li.label: proud lineage
li.description: My people were shaped by another world. I carry it in my body.

li.label: impure blood around
li.description: There are people of strange lineages among us. Humans should stay human.

PreceptDef.label: celebrated
PreceptDef.description: The marks other worlds leave on a people are a source of pride.

PreceptDef.label: shunned
PreceptDef.description: Humans should stay as they were on Earth. Altered lineages are unwelcome.

li.label: prize ship
li.description: We took a whole ship. A good prize for brave raiders.

li.label: stolen ship
li.description: We took another crew's ship. We are no better than pirates.

PreceptDef.label: honorable
PreceptDef.description: Taking ships by boarding is the highest form of courage.

PreceptDef.label: abhorrent
PreceptDef.description: Capturing other crews' ships is theft and shame.

li.label: nameless ship
li.description: Our ship has no name. A nameless ship has no soul.

li.label: named ship
li.description: Our ship carries a proper name. She is one of us.

PreceptDef.label: required
PreceptDef.description: Every ship must carry a name. A nameless ship is bad luck.

li.label: no window to the stars
li.description: There is no viewport on this ship. Living without seeing the sky is unbearable.

li.label: window to the stars
li.description: The ship has a viewport. Looking out at the stars keeps me sane.

PreceptDef.label: needed
PreceptDef.description: People need to see the sky. A ship must have viewports.

MemeDef.label: stellar ascension
MemeDef.description: Humanity must climb toward the stars until it becomes something more. Every world charted and every lineage born is a step up.

MemeDef.label: homeworld guardians
MemeDef.description: Our place is our homeworld. The stars are for visiting, never for living.

MemeDef.label: void faith
MemeDef.description: The void between stars is the face of god. Its silence is a prayer, and the dead return to it.

MemeDef.label: frontier
MemeDef.description: The frontier is where people are free. Whoever charts a world first has the right to it.

PreceptDef.label: ship baptism
PreceptDef.description: A gathering to bless a new or renamed ship. The leader speaks, the crew drinks to the hull, and everyone celebrates.

PreceptDef.label: first jump
PreceptDef.description: A celebration held before or after a long jump, to keep the crew's spirits high in the dark between stars.

PreceptDef.label: void funeral
PreceptDef.description: A farewell for the dead who were given to the void. The crew gathers, remembers them and shares a meal.

PreceptDef.label: star vigil
PreceptDef.description: A quiet night watching the stars together, telling stories of the worlds left behind.

PreceptDef.label: arrival feast
PreceptDef.description: A feast to celebrate reaching a new world or a long-awaited port.

PreceptDef.label: crew oath
PreceptDef.description: The crew renews its oath to the ship and to each other.

PreceptDef.label: captain
PreceptDef.description: The ship's captain commands with authority. Better at negotiating and harder to break.

PreceptDef.label: navigator
PreceptDef.description: Reads the stars and plots the jumps. Learns faster and aims better.

PreceptDef.label: ship guardian
PreceptDef.description: Keeps the hull whole. Builds and repairs much faster.

PreceptDef.label: herald
PreceptDef.description: Speaks for the crew to other civilizations. A great negotiator and trader.
